name: Quadriceps Tendon Rupture
definition: Partial or complete rupture of the quadriceps tendon above the patella, causing impaired active knee extension.

investigations.principle: Clinical diagnosis is supported by imaging.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs assess patellar position and fracture.

amber: Complete rupture generally requires surgical repair.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu/Snayu rupture phenotype may be documented only after orthopedic diagnosis.

patientEducation.summary: Partial or complete rupture of the quadriceps tendon above the patella, causing impaired active knee extension.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
